css: .eyebrow,.foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font:10px var(--mono);letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--muted)}.eyebrow>span:first-child{color:var(--accent)}.hero{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;margin:26px 0 22px}.hero>div{flex:1}h1{font-size:clamp(20px,4vw,30px);font-weight:400;line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 10px;max-width:360px}p{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin:0}.hero canvas{width:128px;height:72px;image-rendering:pixelated;flex-shrink:0}.readout{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;font:10px var(--mono);color:var(--muted)}.readout strong{font-size:36px;letter-spacing:-2px;color:var(--text);font-weight:400}.readout>span:last-child{margin-left:auto}.track{height:5px;background:var(--raised);margin:12px 0 18px}.track div{height:100%;background:var(--accent);transition:width .5s;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,100% calc(100% - 2px),calc(100% - 2px) calc(100% - 2px),calc(100% - 2px) 100%,0 100%)}#stages{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:22px}.stage{font-size:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding-top:12px;color:var(--muted)}.stage b{display:block;font:10px var(--mono);margin-bottom:8px}.stage.active{color:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}.stage.done{color:var(--green)}.foot{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding-top:14px}button{padding:6px 0;border:0;background:none;color:var(--accent);font:11px var(--mono)}@media(max-width:440px){.hero{gap:10px;margin:18px 0}.hero canvas{width:80px;height:45px}.readout strong{font-size:30px}.readout>span:last-child{font-size:9px}.eyebrow,.foot{font-size:9px}}
script: const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);let current={},animation;const reduced=matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');tailnet.onData(data=>{current=data;cancelAnimationFrame(animation);animation=requestAnimationFrame(frame);$('state').textContent=data.status==='working'?'RUNNING':'COMPLETE';$('label').textContent=data.label;$('detail').textContent=data.detail;$('percentage').textContent=Math.round(data.progress)+'%';$('count').textContent=data.completed+' / '+data.total+' ITEMS';$('bar').style.width=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,data.progress))+'%';$('elapsed').textContent=data.elapsed;$('stages').replaceChildren(...data.stages.map((stage,index)=>{const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='stage '+stage.status;const number=document.createElement('b');number.textContent=String(index+1).padStart(2,'0')+' / '+(stage.status==='done'?'DONE':stage.status==='active'?'RUNNING':'QUEUED');el.append(number,document.createTextNode(stage.name));return el}))});$('inspect').onclick=()=>tailnet.action('inspect',{tab:'output'});const canvas=document.querySelector('canvas'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');const bayer=[0,8,2,10,12,4,14,6,3,11,1,9,15,7,13,5];function frame(t){ctx.clearRect(0,0,128,72);const active=current.status==='working';const time=active?t/1000:0;for(let y=0;y<24;y++)for(let x=0;x<42;x++){const ridge=12+Math.sin(x*.13-time*1.4)*6+Math.sin(x*.31+time*.7)*2;const intensity=Math.max(0,1-Math.abs(y-ridge)/8)*(0.3+x/60);if(intensity*16>bayer[(x%4)+(y%4)*4]){ctx.fillStyle=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--accent');ctx.fillRect(x*3,y*3,2,2)}}if(active&&!document.hidden&&!reduced.matches)animation=requestAnimationFrame(frame)}document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{cancelAnimationFrame(animation);if(!document.hidden)animation=requestAnimationFrame(frame)});
